title: 산업융합 촉진법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20251001:00003:part:1/1

Article (Rules for the Implementation of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its Affiliated Institutions) <Item 1, October 1, 2025>

Article 1 (Effective Date) This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation. However, if any decree promulgated before the effective date of this rule, but revised according to Article 5 of these rules, has not yet come into effect, it shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 to 4 are omitted.

Article 5 (Revision of Other Decrees) Items ① to <20> are omitted.

<21> The following portions of the Rules for the Implementation of the Act on Promotion of Industrial Fusion are revised:

Item 2, excluding each item, shall be changed from "Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy Decree" to "Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy Decree."

Item 3, paragraph 1, excluding each item, and paragraph 2 of the same article shall be changed from "Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy" to "Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy."

In Appendix 1, format, "Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy" shall be changed to "Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy," and in the processing procedure section of the same format, "Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy" shall be changed to "Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy."

Articles 22 to 54 are omitted.
